title: ‘Israeli Asset’: How Kushner Screwed Iran Negotiations
author: Team Zeteo
content:
21 hours later, US-Iran ceasefire talks crashed and failed, courtesy of the
dream team sent to seal the deal: _" Loser-in-Chief"_ JD Vance, Steve Witkoff,
and, of course, noted _" failed property developer"_ and _"[Israeli
asset](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/mar/17/uk-security-adviser-
attended-us-iran-talks-and-judged-deal-was-within-reach)"_ Jared Kushner.

**" This is a government filled with inept, incompetent people,"**says
**Mehdi** to **Prem** as they break down what went wrong on 'Ask the Editor' -
**Zeteo 's** weekly live show where subscribers can ask questions on
[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@zeteo/streams) and
[Substack](https://zeteo.com/).
